title: Not great, not bad enough to return
text: Not great, not bad enough to return. I mean, it's fine. There are some 'lips' and crevices that require a toothpick to clean, which is annoying. The molds aren't deep at all and it makes smaller than 4" waffles (3" maybe). Disappointed because I was expecting it turned out more substantial waffles/chaffles/churwaffles.
